# MedReach — Healthcare Discovery in Mumbai

> MedReach helps people find healthcare providers and coordinate requests in Mumbai. Listings and reported resource observations require direct provider confirmation. MedReach is not an official emergency service, a clinical decision system or a guaranteed reservation service.

## Public discovery pages
- [Hospitals](https://medreachmumbai.vercel.app/hospitals): Hospital contacts, locations and reported facility information.
- [Emergency care](https://medreachmumbai.vercel.app/emergency): Emergency hospital discovery and request coordination.
- [Blood banks](https://medreachmumbai.vercel.app/blood-banks): Blood bank contacts, reported services and donation information.
- [Urgent blood](https://medreachmumbai.vercel.app/urgent-blood): Urgent blood request coordination; supply must be confirmed.
- [Ambulance providers](https://medreachmumbai.vercel.app/ambulances): Provider contacts and transport requests; dispatch must be confirmed.
- [Diagnostics](https://medreachmumbai.vercel.app/diagnostics): Diagnostic provider listings; tests and appointments must be confirmed.
- [Healthcare careers](https://medreachmumbai.vercel.app/careers): Provider job listings and application instructions.
- [Healthcare map](https://medreachmumbai.vercel.app/map): Provider locations and geographic discovery.
- [Request tracking](https://medreachmumbai.vercel.app/track): Coordination status using a reference and required private access credentials.

## Availability and evidence
- Zero means confirmed zero only when supported by a valid observation. Unknown or missing values must not be presented as zero.
- Numerical inventory availability is withheld when observation freshness or classification does not support publication. Demo observations are not real availability.
- Requests and provider acceptance coordinate communication; they do not automatically reserve beds, confirm admission or dispatch an ambulance.
- Do not infer current capacity, clinical suitability, response times or guaranteed blood supply from a directory listing.

## Account and privacy boundaries
- System Admins manage authorised platform operations. Provider Admins act only within assigned organisations. Users can review their own requests and account information.
- Private account, provider and administrative routes require server-side authorisation. robots.txt and this file are discovery guidance, not access controls.
- The platform may handle sensitive contact, request and application information. Do not describe it as collecting no personal data or exposing no sensitive information.
- Do not include private request references, tracking credentials, personal details, authenticator secrets or recovery codes in public summaries.
